description:
*Job Types: Full-time*

*Job Description: Center Director/ Center Manager*

Position Overview: As a Center Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations, educational programs, and overall administration of a preschool facility. Your primary focus will be to ensure a safe, nurturing, and educational environment for young children. You will lead a team of teachers and staff; collaborate with parents.

*Key Responsibilities:*

*Program Leadership and Management:*

* Supervise and support teachers and staff, providing guidance, feedback, and professional development opportunities.

* Establish and maintain high standards of educational excellence, ensuring a well-rounded and developmentally appropriate curriculum.

* Regularly assess the program's effectiveness, making adjustments and improvements as needed to meet the evolving needs of the children and families.

*Child Development Management:*

* Creating a Safe and Nurturing Environment: It is crucial to establish a safe, inclusive, and stimulating environment for children.

* Collaborate with parents, teachers, and specialists to develop and implement individualized plans.

* Establish open and effective lines of communication with parents or guardians. Keep them informed about their child's development, progress, and any concerns or milestones reached.

*Admission In-charge:*

* Plan and implement marketing strategies for the school in nearby communities

* Conduct & monitor enquiries for parents who visit

* Record and report on admission enquiries.

* Monitor follow up of parents who have enquired for admission

*Parent Relationship Management:*

* Parent and Community Engagement

* Foster positive and collaborative relationships with parents and families, serving as a point of contact for enquiries, feedback, and concerns.

* Organize and conduct parent meetings, orientations, and other events to promote parent involvement and education.

* Establish effective communication channels to keep parents informed about their child's progress, upcoming activities, and any relevant updates.

*Operational Oversight:*

* Ensure compliance with licensing regulations, health and safety guidelines, and any other legal requirements.

* Develop and maintain policies and procedures related to enrollment, attendance, health, safety, and emergency protocols.

* Manage daily operations, including scheduling, staffing, budgeting, and resource allocation.

* Liaison with different departments within organization

* Maintain accurate records, documentation, and reporting as required by and the preschool's policies.

*Staff Development and Training:*

* Recruit, hire, and onboard qualified teachers and staff members.

* Provide ongoing training, mentoring, and professional development opportunities to enhance the skills and knowledge of the team.

* Foster a positive work environment that promotes teamwork, open communication, and professional growth.

* Financial and Budget Management

*Community Relations and Partnerships:*

* Build positive relationships with community organizations, educational forums, and other relevant stakeholders.

* Seek and develop partnerships that enhance the preschool's resources, services, and community involvement.

* Represent the preschool at community events, conferences, and networking opportunities.

*Qualifications and Skills:*

* Bachelors or master's degree in early childhood education, child development, or a related field. Advanced degrees are preferred.

* Relevant experience in a leadership role within a preschool or early childhood education setting.

* Comprehensive knowledge of early childhood education principles, curriculum development, and age-appropriate teaching methods.

* Strong leadership and managerial skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with children, parents, staff, and external stakeholders.

* Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities to manage operations, resolve issues, and make informed decisions.

* Proficiency in using educational software, administrative tools, and digital communication platforms.

* Ability to work collaboratively and build relationships with diverse individuals and communities.

* Flexibility to adapt to changing needs and demands of the preschool environment.

SDR World School is looking for a passionate, skilled, and dedicated *Primary Mathematics Teacher* to teach Mathematics to students from Grades 1 to 5. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of primary-level mathematical concepts, excellent classroom management skills, and the ability to make Mathematics engaging, interactive, and easy for young learners to understand.

* Patience and a genuine interest in teaching young children.

* Effective classroom management and time-management skills.
* Ability to identify and address individual learning needs.
* Professional attitude, punctuality, and commitment to academic excellence.

* Prepare and deliver engaging, interactive and student-focused lessons.

title: Computer Teacher
subject: Computer Science & AI
description:
Computer Science Trainer
Location: District headquarters of any of the following districts (Angul, Balangir, Malkangiri, Sonepur, Boudh, Nuapada) in Odisha
Salary: 6 –10 Lakhs
Basis: Permanent; full-time, part time or flexible
Eligibility: You must be eligible to work in India

The role

We’re looking for a Computer Science Trainer to join our team in Odisha, who will plan, coordinate and deliver all of our state training and educator development activities, and will also work closely with the State team and curriculum team in India to support the Foundation’s work in computing curriculum development, teacher training, and related teaching and learning activities.

We work hard to make sure that the Foundation is a place where everyone is supported to do the best work of their careers. We have a flexible and collaborative approach to all aspects of our work. If you're the right person for the job, we’ll make it work for you, and you can be confident that you’ll be joining an exceptional team of people who care about our mission and each other.

Responsibilities

Contribute to the expansion of our computing education work in schools and other educational settings for young people (5 - 25 years) in the state of Odisha
Deliver and evaluate teacher training and ongoing capacity building sessions throughout Odisha, including face-to-face training, online webinars, and school visits to observe lessons and have coaching conversations
Nurture and support an educator community through being the point of contact for enquiries and regular initiatives like virtual and in person meet-ups and sharing learning opportunities.
Plan and manage the logistical aspects of educator training and local programmes in collaboration with colleagues, including scouting for and interfacing with venues, securing equipment and supplies, and conducting pre-event checks
Support in the planning and execution of our partner onboarding strategy for state-level projects and partnerships including the computing teacher needs assessment, nomination and selection process.
Ensure all partners’ local trainers understand and adhere to the partnership agreement terms, including training standards and safeguarding requirements
Collaborate with fellow partners on programme-related additional activities throughout the year
Support the colleagues working on impact and curriculum development to develop and deliver monitoring, evaluation, and development tools for teachers and learners to progress tracking
Collaborate with colleagues to support the development, quality assurance, and continuous improvement of computing education courses and programmes needed for Odisha, and ensure that best practices are shared across the Foundation
Build relationships with key government stakeholders to support the adoption of our work in the state
Represent the Raspberry Pi Foundation to external audiences, including writing blog posts and magazine articles, attending outreach events, and leading workshops as and when required

Experience and personal attributes

We recognise that everyone has the potential for growth. We welcome applications from candidates who can demonstrate that they have some, but not necessarily all, of the experience and personal attributes listed here.

A commitment to the mission and values of the Raspberry Pi Foundation
Substantial teaching experience, and experience of designing and delivering effective and engaging training and training of trainers, ideally with a specialism in computing education or a related field; a qualification in teaching is preferable
Bachelor’s degree or higher in the STEM field
In-depth knowledge of how the formal education systems work in Odisha, including curriculum and teacher training requirements and delivery methods and the processes by which schools and communities adopt new programmes
Substantial project and programme management experience, including supporting delivery of large-scale, complex projects and contracts and monitoring and evaluation
Ability to engage with and manage critical on-ground government stakeholders during programme implementation work
Familiarity with online learning experiences and products, with an understanding of how technology is changing learning is preferable
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; proficient in reading, writing, and verbal communication in Odia
A collaborative, flexible, and solutions-focused approach, with the ability to manage conflicting priorities and complexity
Good data, analytical, and reporting skills, and the ability to use data effectively to improve what we do
Preferably, experience of working in international organisations
Comfort with regular travel to schools in different parts of the state for meetings, training sessions, and support to teachers in effective implementation of the curriculum and necessary audits

About us

The Raspberry Pi Foundation is an independent charity with a global mission to enable all young people to realise their full potential through the power of computing and digital technologies. We operate through Raspberry Pi Foundation Educational Services incorporated in India, to provide educational services.

We empower schools to teach computer science and AI literacy through free curricula, classroom resources, purpose built software tools, and professional development for teachers. We inspire young people to become tech creators through the world's largest networks of coding clubs. We undertake original research that informs our work and which we use to advance the field of computer science education more broadly.

All of our resources and learning experiences are available for anyone to use at no cost. We are particularly focused on creating opportunities for young people who experience educational disadvantage and those who come from backgrounds traditionally underrepresented in technology industries.

Over the past decade, we have supported hundreds of thousands of educators and tens of millions of students. We have teams in six countries (India, Ireland, Kenya, South Africa, the UK and US) and partnerships with mission-aligned non-profit organisations in over 60 countries.

We are at the forefront of the global educational movement to expand access to computer science education and AI literacy. You can learn more about our work in our latest Annual Report.

Benefits

In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a wide range of benefits for all of our colleagues, including:

Competitive leave allowance. From day one, you'll benefit from 17 days of earned leave, 13 days of sick leave, and 16 national/regional leaves; 2nd and 4th Saturdays off
Generous Employee Provident Fund (EPF). The EPF is a retirement savings scheme where both employees and employers contribute 12%
Comprehensive Group Medical Insurance. We provide Private Healthcare via a Group Medical Insurance provided by NivaBupa. Each colleague has a sum assured amount of ₹10,000,00
Flexible working. We have clear policies to provide flexibility over when and where you work, helping you balance work responsibilities with the rest of your life.
Support for parents and carers. We provide generous family leave and flexibility for parents and carers.
Group Term Life Insurance. We provide life assurance and income protection schemes to provide peace of mind for you and your family.
Investing in learning and development. We invest in your growth and development, including through access to learning resources and training, with dedicated time for all employees.

Timetable for applications

Closing date: rolling
Phone screen: rolling basis
First interview: rolling basis
Second interview: rolling basis

Our recruitment process

All of our workplaces are inclusive spaces where we want people to feel respected, valued, and able to do their best work. We are committed to building teams that bring together people with a broad range of backgrounds, skills, and perspectives. That starts with our recruitment process.

Here's what you can expect:

As part of your application, you will be asked to respond to a small number of questions that we will use to screen your eligibility for the role. You will also be asked to provide your cv and a short cover letter.
Eligible applications will be reviewed by our recruitment team and the hiring manager.
A small number of candidates will be invited to a phone call with the hiring manager. The purpose of this call is to check our understanding of your application and to answer any questions you have.
We normally have two interviews, at least one of which will take place in-person. Interviews will be with the hiring manager and at least one other colleague.
You will usually be asked to undertake a work-based assessment in advance of your interviews. This will be an opportunity for you to show how you would perform some part of the role. You will be given advance notice and clear instructions.
If you have any questions about or feel that you need any adjustments to the recruitment process, including adjustments for neurodiversity, please contact our People and Culture team at recruitment@raspberrypi.org.

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people, and we expect all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. Everyone appointed to a role at the Foundation will be required to undergo a background check to confirm that you are a suitable person to work with children. Further background checks will be made at regular intervals thereafter.

1. *Job Summary*

Resonance World School is seeking an experienced, dynamic, and result-oriented School Principal to lead the academic and administrative operations of the institution. The ideal candidate should have strong leadership abilities, sound knowledge of CBSE curriculum and guidelines, excellent communication skills, and the ability to maintain high standards of academic excellence, discipline, and overall school development.

2. *Key Responsibilities*

A. *Academic Leadership*

* Lead, supervise, and monitor the academic activities of the school in accordance with CBSE guidelines.
* Ensure effective implementation of the curriculum, lesson plans, academic calendars, and assessment schedules.
* Monitor teaching quality through classroom observations, teacher evaluations, and academic reviews.
* Develop strategies to improve students’ academic performance and learning outcomes.
* Ensure timely completion of the syllabus and effective implementation of examination and assessment systems.
* Promote activity-based, experiential, and technology-enabled teaching methodologies.
* Review students’ academic progress and take corrective measures wherever required.

B. *Staff Management and Development*

* Supervise and guide teaching and non-teaching staff to ensure effective performance.
* Participate in teacher recruitment, selection, induction, and staff deployment.
* Conduct regular staff meetings, academic reviews, and professional development sessions.
* Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, discipline, and adherence to school policies.
* Provide constructive feedback and mentoring to teachers to improve teaching effectiveness.
* Foster a professional, collaborative, and accountable work culture within the school.

C. *Administrative Management*

* Oversee the day-to-day functioning of the school and ensure smooth academic and administrative operations.
* Coordinate with the management, HR department, accounts department, transport department, and other administrative teams.
* Ensure proper maintenance of school records, registers, reports, and official documentation.
* Monitor school infrastructure, classrooms, laboratories, library, sports facilities, and other resources.
* Ensure effective implementation of school policies, procedures, and operational standards.
* Submit regular reports on academic performance, staff matters, student discipline, and school operations to the management.

D. *CBSE Compliance and Documentation*

* Supervise the maintenance and updating of mandatory school records and statutory documentation.
* Coordinate the preparation and submission of CBSE-related reports, declarations, and other required documents.
* Monitor the implementation of school quality assessment and improvement initiatives.
* Ensure that academic and administrative practices remain aligned with applicable education regulations.

E. *Student Discipline and Welfare*

* Maintain discipline, punctuality, and appropriate conduct among students.
* Ensure a safe, inclusive, and supportive learning environment.
* Address student grievances, behavioural concerns, and disciplinary matters fairly and professionally.
* Promote students’ participation in co-curricular activities, sports, competitions, and leadership programmes.
* Coordinate with teachers and counsellors to support students’ academic, emotional, and social development.
* Ensure compliance with child protection, student safety, and safeguarding policies.

F. *Parent and Community Relations*

* Maintain effective communication with parents and address their concerns professionally.
* Conduct parent-teacher meetings and review student progress with relevant staff.
* Build positive relationships with parents and the local community.
* Represent the school at official meetings, educational events, and relevant institutional programmes.
* Support school admissions, orientation programmes, and parent engagement initiatives.

G. *School Development and Leadership*

* Work closely with the school management to achieve institutional goals and improve overall performance.
* Develop and implement annual academic plans and school improvement strategies.
* Monitor key performance indicators related to academics, staff performance, student retention, and discipline.
* Promote innovation, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to school branding, reputation building, and the development of a positive institutional culture.

* Experience working in a CBSE-affiliated school will be an advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, improve academic outcomes, and manage school operations effectively.

* Excellent leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.

*A Senior Secondary Economics Teacher (or PGT Economics)* is responsible for delivering complex economic concepts to upper high school students (typically Grades 11 and 12, or equivalent sixth-form levels). This educator prepares students for major board or national examinations (such as CBSE, IBDP, IGCSE, or NIOS) by breaking down foundational theories in microeconomics, macroeconomics, and statistical tools.

The ideal candidate simplifies intricate fiscal policies, market mechanisms, and statistical data while maintaining a student-centered, disciplined learning environment.

* *Assessment & Evaluation*: Formulate periodic test papers, assignments, and case studies, offering actionable feedback to track individual growth.

The institution runs three converging tracks: Olympiad training (age 6+), research and publication (age 14+), and leadership programs connecting students with real-world problems (age 14+). Cheenta operates an academic management platform, Panini8, built in-house. This role sits at the centre of what Cheenta does: teaching physics through interesting, non-routine problems, and doing genuine research alongside it. It is a role for someone who enjoys problem solving for its own sake and intends to build a research career.

Role Summary

The Assistant Faculty and Researcher carries two connected responsibilities. As faculty, the role teaches nonroutine physics to Cheenta's students and carries the preparation, grading, and feedback that good teaching requires. As researcher, the role contributes to research projects under the direction and mentoring of senior faculty. The position is designed for a strong problem solver who wants to grow into higher academic work. Substantial in-house training is provided — so problem-solving aptitude and the willingness to learn matter more than prior teaching credentials.

Responsibilities

*A. Teaching — Classroom and Sessions (20 hours / week)*

* Teach scheduled physics sessions, working from non-routine, problem-first material rather than rote drill.
* Lead students through olympiad-style physics problems — mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, waves and optics, and modern physics — building reasoning, not just answers.
* Adapt pace and depth to the level of each group, from younger Olympiad entrants to advanced students.
* Keep sessions engaging and rigorous, and maintain a record of what each group has covered.

*B. Research — Mentored Projects (10 hours / week)*

* Contribute to active research projects under the direction and mentoring of senior faculty.
* Read, work through, and present relevant problems, papers, and results as guided by your mentor.
* Maintain clear, well-organised notes and write-ups of research work.
* Take research direction from senior faculty; this is a mentored, contributing role rather than an independent one.

*C. Teaching-Related Work (10 hours / week)*

* Prepare problem sets, session plans, and supporting material ahead of class.
* Grade student work and assessments, and give clear, specific written feedback.
* Track student progress and flag students who need additional support.
* Coordinate with other faculty on shared groups, content, and the academic calendar.

_*Teaching — classroom and sessions: 20 hrs.*_

_*Mentored research projects: 10 hrs.*_

_*Teaching-related work — preparation, grading, feedback: 10 hrs.*_

_*Defined weekly commitment: 40 hrs*_

*Required Qualifications*

* A Master's degree in Physics, or near completion. Exceptional Bachelor's-level candidates with a strong problem-solving record will be considered.
* Demonstrated strength in, and enthusiasm for, non-routine problem solving. A formal olympiad record is not required — what matters is genuine problem-solving ability and the appetite to learn.
* A genuine interest in research and in pursuing higher academic study over time.
* Clear spoken and written English, and the confidence to teach live.
* Willingness to work the in-office night shift in Kolkata.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Any experience teaching or mentoring physics — tutoring, coaching, or classroom work — is a plus, but not expected.
* Research exposure: project work, a thesis, publications, or sustained reading beyond coursework.
* Familiarity with LaTeX for typesetting problems and write-ups.
* Comfort with the experimental and computational side of physics — laboratory reasoning, data analysis, or numerical tools — is welcome.
* Basic familiarity with Bengali in addition to English, for communication with younger students.
* Comfort with online or blended teaching tools and academic platforms.

*Compensation and Benefits*

* ₹27,000 – ₹40,000 per month, in-hand, set by skill and experience.
* This is a night-shift position and carries the higher salary band.
* Health insurance for the employee.
* Statutory benefits as applicable.

*Working Conditions*

Full-time and office-based at 22 Lake Place, Kolkata 700029. This is a Kolkata, in-office position only. The role follows the night-shift structure, which carries the higher salary band:

NIGHT SHIFT · HIGHER BAND 11:00 PM – 8:00 AM IST

Higher salary band. Aligned to overseas student sessions.

SUPPORT & HANDOVER Daily faculty handover

Coordinated with the day-shift team on shared groups.

* Substantial in-house training is provided in Cheenta's problem-first teaching method and in research practice; new faculty are trained, not expected to arrive fully formed.
* During probation, the working week is six days, including the weekend, with one scheduled week-off on a weekday.
* Six-month probation with a structured review at month three and month six.
* Equipment, software access, and reference material are provided by the organisation.

*Growth and Academic Mentoring*

Faculty at Cheenta receive structured mentoring toward higher academic goals. Senior faculty guide reading, research direction, and applications to PhD and graduate programs — in India, the United States, Europe, and elsewhere. For a strong problem solver who wants a research career, this role is built to be a step toward it, not a detour from it.

*Scope and Limits of the Role*

* Research direction and project design rest with senior faculty. This role contributes and learns under mentoring; it is not an independent research position.
* Teaching follows Cheenta's problem-first approach — non-routine physics, reasoning over rote. Curriculum and pedagogy direction stay with senior faculty.

*How to Apply*

Send the following to talent@cheenta.org:

* A current CV.
* A short note (200 words or fewer) on why problem solving and research appeal to you, and where you would like your academic career to go.
* One solved-problem write-up: choose a non-routine physics problem you enjoy and explain your solution clearly, in about one page.
* Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a short problem-solving and teaching assessment, followed by an interview with senior faculty and the Director.
* *Applications without a solved-problem write-up will not be reviewed.*

*Professional Development*: PGT Maths teachers need to keep themselves updated with the latest teaching techniques, trends, and technologies related to the subject of Maths. They need to attend workshops, conferences, and training sessions to enhance their teaching skills and knowledge.

*Collaborating with Colleagues*: PGT Maths teachers need to collaborate and work in a team with other Maths teachers and colleagues to develop and implement effective teaching strategies and share best practices.

*About ACHARIYA World Class Education*

ACHARIYA World Class Education is committed to delivering quality education through academic excellence, innovative teaching methodologies, holistic student development, and future-ready learning experiences.

We are looking for an experienced, visionary, and result-oriented School Principal to lead the overall academic, administrative, and operational functioning of our school.

The Principal will play a critical role in building a high-performance academic culture, strengthening teaching quality, developing leadership teams, ensuring effective curriculum implementation, and achieving institutional goals.

*Key Responsibilities1. Academic Leadership & Excellence*

* Provide overall academic leadership from Pre-Primary to Grade XII.
* Ensure effective implementation of the CBSE curriculum and ACHARIYA's academic framework.
* Monitor common portions, common assessments, examination schedules, and academic standards.
* Ensure timely syllabus completion and effective lesson planning across all grades.
* Drive innovative teaching methodologies, experiential learning, and competency-based education.
* Monitor classroom teaching quality through regular observations and academic audits.
* Analyse student performance and implement targeted academic improvement strategies.
* Ensure strong academic outcomes in CBSE Board Examinations.

*2. Implementation of ACHARIYA's Academic Programmes*

* Ensure effective implementation of the school's academic and enrichment programmes.
* Monitor the implementation of Divya Srishty, Divya Vidhya, Abacus, Aptitude & Reasoning, and other prescribed learning programmes.
* Promote Critical Thinking, Computational Thinking, and Creative Thinking among students.
* Encourage activity-based, experiential, and multidisciplinary learning.
* Ensure effective integration of technology and digital learning resources into classroom teaching.
* Monitor implementation of school-wide academic initiatives and management directives.

*3. Academic Team Leadership*

* Lead and supervise academic coordinators across Pre-Primary, Primary, Upper Primary, Secondary, and Senior Secondary sections.
* Establish clear KRAs, responsibilities, and performance expectations for academic leaders and teachers.
* Conduct regular performance reviews of coordinators, Heads of Sections, and teachers.
* Identify teacher training requirements and ensure continuous professional development.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and academic excellence.
* Ensure optimal teacher deployment and effective utilisation of academic resources.

*4. Student Performance & Development*

* Monitor student academic progress and learning outcomes.
* Identify learning gaps and ensure structured remedial and enrichment programmes.
* Ensure effective assessment, evaluation, and student progress tracking.
* Promote sports, arts, life skills, leadership, and co-curricular activities.
* Ensure student discipline, safety, well-being, and holistic development.
* Encourage participation in academic competitions, Olympiads, and other enrichment programmes.

*5. School Administration & Operations*

* Oversee the day-to-day academic and administrative operations.
* Ensure effective coordination among all departments and academic sections.
* Monitor staff attendance, student attendance, discipline, and institutional functioning.
* Ensure compliance with CBSE regulations, school policies, and statutory requirements.
* Ensure proper maintenance of academic records, documentation, and school data.
* Monitor infrastructure, classroom readiness, safety, and campus standards.

*6. Parent Engagement & Relationship Management*

* Build strong relationships with parents and strengthen parent confidence in the institution.
* Conduct regular parent-teacher meetings and academic review sessions.
* Ensure timely identification and resolution of parent grievances.
* Promote parent participation in classroom observations, school events, and academic activities.
* Establish effective communication systems between teachers, parents, and school leadership.

*7. Admissions & Institutional Growth*

* Work closely with the admissions team to achieve student enrolment targets.
* Strengthen student retention and parent satisfaction.
* Support admission campaigns, school events, outreach programmes, and promotional activities.
* Enhance the school's reputation through academic excellence and quality service.
* Identify opportunities for institutional improvement and growth.

*8. Performance Monitoring & Reporting*

* Submit regular academic, administrative, and operational reports to management.
* Monitor institutional KPIs and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
* Review academic performance, teacher effectiveness, admissions, and parent satisfaction.
* Conduct regular leadership meetings and review action points.
* Ensure timely implementation of management directives.
* Use ERP, digital dashboards, and reporting systems for data-driven decision-making.

* Master's Degree in Education (M.Ed.) or a Master's Degree in a relevant subject with B.Ed.
* B.Ed. is mandatory.
* 10–15 years of experience in the school education sector.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a senior leadership role as Principal, Vice Principal, or Academic Head.
* Strong understanding of CBSE curriculum, school administration, and academic quality standards.
* Experience in managing large academic teams and multiple academic sections.
* Experience in implementing innovative educational programmes is preferred.

About uDot
uDot (uDot Braille Tech Pvt Ltd) is a Bengaluru assistive-technology and ed-tech startup. We have built a refreshable tactile display, a ~2,400-pin device that renders Braille, diagrams and graphs, paired with a curriculum-aligned learning platform that lets blind and visually impaired students learn Math independently.
Over 95% of blind children in India drop Math by Grade 7, because there is no way for them to engage with these subjects on their own. We are changing that.
Where you fit in
You will be the person students learn with, teachers call and new schools first meet. What you see in classrooms comes back to the team and shapes the product and content.

You will work independently in the field, with regular check-ins from Bengaluru. We value people who take ownership, learn quickly and follow through. Prior experience in accessibility is not essential, but care for inclusive learning is.

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a passionate English educator who can strengthen teachers' English language skills and transform school libraries into active spaces for reading and learning.
The role involves training and mentoring teachers, promoting phonics and foundational literacy, developing language-learning resources, and building a sustainable reading culture among teachers and students.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Improve teachers' English communication skills (Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing).
Train teachers in English phonics, pronunciation, vocabulary and foundational literacy.
Establish, organize and enhance school libraries.
Promote reading through storytelling, read-alouds, reading circles and other library-based activities.
Demonstrate how to integrate library resources into everyday classroom teaching.
Conduct teacher training, model lessons, classroom observations and mentoring.
Develop English learning materials, worksheets, reading resources and teacher guides.
Monitor implementation, document progress and report outcomes.
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Graduate or postgraduate degree in English, English Literature, Education or a related field.
B.Ed. preferred; M.A./M.Ed. is an added advantage.
Minimum 3 years of experience as an English teacher, teacher educator, literacy facilitator or language specialist.
Proven ability to improve reading practices and promote effective library utilization will be highly preferred.
REQUIRED SKILLS
Excellent spoken and written English.
Strong knowledge of English phonics and language teaching.
Ability to develop teachers' Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing (LSRW) skills.
Strong training, facilitation and mentoring abilities.
Good drafting, editing and content-development skills.
Ability to design practical language-learning and library-based activities.
Good interpersonal, documentation and reporting skills.
Basic digital skills
Willingness to travel to the project schools.
WHO SHOULD APPLY?
We are looking for someone who:
Sees teacher empowerment and literacy development as a mission, not just a job.
Is passionate about English, books, reading and language development.
Believes every teacher can improve with the right guidance and support.
Enjoys working directly with teachers and schools.
Can turn language concepts into practical classroom activities.
Takes ownership of outcomes and follows through until new practices become habits.
Is proactive, self-driven, adaptable and committed to continuous learning.
Wants to create a lasting reading culture in schools.
WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY
This role is NOT for someone who:
Is looking only for a salary, designation or routine job.
Is interested in conducting training sessions but not in following up on classroom implementation.
Views a library merely as a place to store books.
Is unwilling to travel to schools or work directly with teachers.
Is unwilling to learn, adapt, receive feedback or take responsibility.
Focuses on completing assigned activities rather than creating meaningful educational change.
OUR EXPECTATION
We do not expect you to know everything from day one. We expect strong English language skills, a genuine passion for reading and teacher development, and the commitment to turn ideas into meaningful action.
At SECT, success is not measured by the number of training sessions or libraries established, but by improved teacher competencies, increased reading engagement, and a lasting culture of learning in schools.
If empowering teachers and inspiring a love for reading is a mission you believe in, we invite you to join us.

title: Headmistress
subject: Pre-Primary
description:
Institution Description :
The King’s School Canterbury, Bengaluru is the newest chapter of The King’s School Canterbury, a historic institution founded in 597 AD. Opening in the academic year 2027–28, the Bengaluru campus will initially welcome children from Nursery to Grade 1. The school brings a long-established educational philosophy and values to a new, thoughtfully planned setting in Bengaluru. It is committed to nurturing the whole child, focusing on academic development, character formation, and well-being.
Assistant Headteacher - Early Years
The Opportunity :
The King’s School Canterbury, Bengaluru seeks an exceptional early years practitioner and developing or established leader to join its founding Pre-Prep team. They will help establish ambitious Nursery and Reception provision and support a culture in which children are known, safe, challenged and happy. Working closely with the Founding Head of Prep, the Assistant Headteacher will lead Early Years education and pastoral care, combining a 50% teaching commitment with implementing agreed priorities and developing colleagues.
Start: August 2027
Application Closing date: 18th December 2026
We welcome applications from experienced Early Years practitioners and developing or established
leaders who meet the published person specification.
Key Responsibilities
1. EYFS Curriculum, Teaching and Learning
Lead the quality and continuous improvement of teaching and learning across Nursery and Reception, aligned with the King’s Educational Framework (KEF) and Teaching and Learning Standards.
Model exemplary practice grounded in child development and EYFS pedagogy, promoting purposeful play, rich oral language, responsive teaching and children’s independence.
Ensure coherent curriculum progression from Nursery into Key Stage 1, informed by children’s views, interests and experiences.
Use observation and assessment to track progress from individual starting points, identify emerging needs and adapt teaching, without creating unnecessary workload.
Lead high-quality continuous provision, ensuring indoor and outdoor environments, routines and adult interactions support learning across all EYFS areas, including communication and language, early literacy and mathematics.
Champion inclusive, multilingual learning environments that support children learning English as an additional language and celebrate Bengaluru’s linguistic and cultural diversity.
Maintain high expectations while preserving childhood, fostering curiosity and ensuring every child feels known, valued and that they belong.
2. Pastoral Care and Wellbeing
Support consistent, developmentally appropriate pastoral systems across the Pre-Prep, promoting a calm, nurturing culture rooted in the King’s values of Readiness, Respect, Resilience and Responsibility.
Ensure positive transitions into school and between phases, with attention to settling-in, attendance, emotional security and home–school relationships.
Work with teachers, the Inclusion Lead, school counsellor and families to identify and support children needing additional pastoral, social or emotional help, escalating concerns through school procedures.
Model restorative approaches to behaviour that prioritise relationships, emotional regulation and the dignity of every child.
3. Safeguarding and Child Protection
Promote a strong safeguarding culture across the Early Years, ensuring staff consistently implement the school’s safeguarding policies and procedures.
Act as Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL) for the Early Years in line with school policy, statutory requirements and COBIS standards, working with the Assistant DSL and wider safeguarding team.
Ensure concerns are promptly identified, recorded and referred, and oversee safeguarding records, information sharing and follow-up, maintaining confidentiality and working appropriately with families and external agencies.
Work with the Founding Head of Prep to secure protected time, training and cover to fulfil DSL duties alongside teaching and leadership.
Contribute to safeguarding induction, training, safer recruitment and monitoring, and promote safe use of technology and online safety.
4. Inclusion and Additional Learning Needs
Work with the Inclusion Lead to embed inclusive practice and promote early identification of additional needs, ensuring timely, developmentally appropriate adaptations that enable all children to participate and progress.
Monitor the impact of agreed support strategies with teachers, the Inclusion Lead and relevant professionals.
Support family communication and transitions for children needing additional support.
5. People Leadership and Professional Development
Line-manage EYFS teachers and support staff within the approved staffing structure.
Support the recruitment, induction, performance management and professional development of EYFS colleagues.
Lead EYFS meetings, collaborative planning and professional learning, ensuring consistent practice and shared accountability.
Develop staff expertise through observation, coaching and mentoring, fostering a collaborative culture of respect, reflection and continuous improvement.
6. Parent Partnerships, Admissions and Community Engagement
Build positive, trusting partnerships with parents, communicating clearly and sensitively about children’s learning, development and wellbeing.
Contribute to parent workshops, events and community initiatives, representing the school with professionalism and promoting its values and educational philosophy.
7. Operations, Quality Assurance and Opening Readiness
Support the Founding Head of Prep in establishing effective operational systems and routines, leading designated areas and providing cover when required within delegated authority.
Lead EYFS opening-readiness priorities, including environments, resources, timetables, assessment, staff induction and pupil transition, ahead of opening in August 2027.
Work with operations and premises teams to ensure environments, supervision, risk assessments, health and safety and hygiene practices suit young children.
Manage EYFS resources, inventories and procurement priorities, contributing to budget planning within agreed parameters.
Contribute to self-evaluation, quality assurance, school improvement planning and external review, including COBIS accreditation.
8. Accountability and Additional Responsibilities
Work under the direction of the Founding Head of Prep, exercising delegated authority responsibly and referring significant decisions through appropriate leadership and governance structures.
Contribute to the wider leadership of the Pre-Prep with flexibility and initiative, and undertake additional duties reasonably delegated, commensurate with the role.
Person specification
Candidates should address the essential criteria through their application and supporting statement.
Essential qualifications and experience
A recognised Early Years or Primary teaching qualification and a relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent; UK QTS or an international equivalent is desirable. Candidates must meet qualification, employment and immigration requirements for India.
Substantial, recent and successful EYFS teaching experience with secure expertise in Nursery and Reception pedagogy, child development and assessment.
Proven educational or pastoral leadership, including implementing improvement priorities, developing colleagues and sustained positive impact on children.
Strong understanding of safeguarding and the ability to act as Early Years DSL; appropriate DSL training must be completed before assuming the role and maintained thereafter.
Experience of pastoral support, family partnership, child-centred behaviour approaches and early identification of additional needs.
Ability to analyse practice, give useful feedback and turn priorities into reliable routines, with excellent English, organisation, discretion and judgement.
Understanding of inclusive approaches for multilingual children and culturally diverse families, and willingness to teach approximately half the timetable in a start-up school.
Desirable qualifications and experience
NPQSL or an equivalent leadership qualification.
Previous experience as EYFS Lead, Phase Leader or Assistant Headteacher.
Experience in a British international school or a school start-up.
DSL training and practical safeguarding leadership experience.
Experience of inspection, accreditation or quality assurance.
Experience working with specialist inclusion teams and external agencies.
Personal qualities
Warm, approachable and genuinely child-centred, with high expectations and thoughtful ambition for each child.
A reflective, credible classroom practitioner who enjoys working with colleagues.
Calm, dependable and decisive, and appropriately consultative on significant matters.
Culturally intelligent, respectful of the Bengaluru context and committed to the King’s ethos.
Able to build trust, handle feedback and sensitive information, and communicate well under pressure.
Selection and safer recruitment
The school is committed to safeguarding children’s welfare and expects all staff to share this commitment. Appointments are subject to safer recruitment procedures, including identity, qualification, employment history, reference and criminal record checks, and confirmation of eligibility to work in India.
Applications are assessed against the published person specification and role requirements.

subject: General Teaching
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Location: Kollur, Hyderabad, Telangana
Reporting To: Principal / Academic Director
1. Job Purpose
The Vice Principal will support the Principal in the effective management of academic programmes, school administration, teacher performance, student discipline, and parent engagement. The role requires a dynamic educational leader who can ensure high academic standards, strengthen teaching practices, and maintain a safe, disciplined, and student-centred learning environment.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Academic Leadership
* Monitor the implementation of the curriculum, lesson plans, and academic calendar.
* Ensure timely completion of the syllabus and achievement of academic targets.
* Conduct regular classroom observations and provide constructive feedback to teachers.
* Monitor students’ academic progress through assessments, examinations, and performance reports.
* Ensure effective implementation of CBSE and Cambridge curriculum requirements, as applicable.
* Identify learning gaps and coordinate remedial and enrichment programmes.
B. Teacher Management & Development
* Supervise teachers, coordinators, and academic teams.
* Monitor teacher punctuality, attendance, classroom preparedness, and professional conduct.
* Conduct regular academic meetings, training sessions, and performance reviews.
* Support new teachers through induction, mentoring, and classroom guidance.
* Ensure teachers maintain lesson plans, class diaries, assessment records, and student portfolios.
* Promote accountability, teamwork, and continuous professional development.
C. Student Discipline & Well-being
* Maintain discipline, punctuality, and appropriate student behaviour across the school.
* Address student concerns, behavioural issues, and disciplinary cases fairly.
* Ensure safeguarding procedures and child protection policies are followed.
* Monitor attendance, student participation, and overall well-being.
* Promote leadership, values, responsibility, and positive student relationships.
D. School Administration & Operations
* Assist the Principal in daily school operations and academic planning.
* Monitor the school timetable, substitution arrangements, examinations, and academic events.
* Conduct regular school rounds to ensure classroom readiness and operational discipline.
* Ensure teaching resources, laboratories, libraries, and learning spaces are effectively utilised.
* Coordinate with the administration, transport, admissions, HR, and support teams when required.
* Maintain accurate academic and administrative records.
E. Parent Communication & Engagement
* Attend parent meetings and address academic or behavioural concerns.
* Ensure timely communication regarding student performance and school expectations.
* Handle parent grievances professionally and escalate sensitive matters to the Principal.
* Support parent orientation programmes, workshops, and school engagement activities.
F. Quality Assurance & School Improvement
* Support internal academic audits and external inspections.
* Review assessment results and prepare action plans for improvement.
* Monitor the implementation of school policies and standard operating procedures.
* Track academic targets, teacher performance, and student outcomes.
* Submit regular reports to the Principal / Academic Director with observations, concerns, and corrective actions.
3. Qualifications & Experience
* Master’s degree in Education or a relevant subject; B.Ed. is mandatory or preferred as per school requirements.
* Minimum 5–8 years of teaching experience, including at least 3 years in an academic leadership or supervisory role.
* Experience in CBSE schools; Cambridge curriculum experience will be an added advantage.
* Strong knowledge of curriculum planning, assessments, classroom management, and teacher development.
* Proficiency in school ERP systems, MS Office, and academic reporting.
4. Required Skills & Competencies
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Effective problem-solving and decision-making.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines.
* Professional integrity, emotional intelligence, and a solution-oriented mindset.
* Commitment to academic excellence, student safety, and institutional growth.
5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The Vice Principal’s performance will be evaluated based on:
1. Timely syllabus completion and academic planning.
2. Improvement in student learning outcomes and assessment performance.
3. Quality and frequency of classroom observations.
4. Teacher performance, punctuality, and accountability.
5. Effective implementation of school policies and academic procedures.
6. Student discipline, attendance, and well-being.
7. Parent satisfaction and timely grievance resolution.
8. Audit compliance and timely submission of reports.
9. Successful execution of examinations, school events, and academic initiatives.
6. Working Expectations
* Be present and actively involved in daily school operations.
* Maintain a visible leadership presence during arrival, dispersal, class transitions, and breaks.
* Conduct regular classroom visits and academic reviews.
* Ensure that concerns are addressed promptly rather than postponed.
* Maintain confidentiality and professional conduct at all times.
* Demonstrate ownership, initiative, and accountability for assigned responsibilities.
7. Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for a proactive, disciplined, and academically strong leader who can work closely with the Principal and teaching team to build a culture of excellence. The ideal candidate should be capable of identifying gaps, implementing corrective measures, mentoring teachers, and ensuring that academic and operational commitments are fulfilled consistently.
The Vice Principal is expected to be a leader who takes ownership, builds a strong team, and translates the school’s vision into measurable outcomes.

Job Title: Principal - Orchids The International School
Location: [Location Specific]
About Us:
Orchids The International School is one of India's premier chains of CBSE and ICSE schools,
with over 90 schools across the country. Our journey began in Hyderabad, and today we have

Asian Education Leadership Awards.

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Principal who will lead our school in achieving

processes. The Principal will be responsible for the entire running of the school, overseeing
academics, operations, and admissions, ensuring a high standard of education, and maintaining

positive experience for students and parents.

houses, and other events to enhance the school's presence and outreach.
Manage social media channels, including Instagram and Facebook, to boost
school visibility and engagement.

Minimum 10 years of experience in academics.
At least 5 years of experience as a Principal in a reputed school.



Strong knowledge of curriculum development and academic best practices.
Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills, with the ability to work with teachers,
parents, and community members.
Effective decision-making skills, strong discipline, and time management abilities.
Proven track record in school administration, operations, and academic planning.
Exposure to marketing, school growth strategies, and the admissions process.
Experience managing social media channels for school visibility and engagement.
Only female candidates will be considered for this role. The age limit is 50 years.
Desired Competencies:
Technical Competencies:
Managing School Operations: Oversee daily operations. Ensure smooth functioning.
Academic Understanding: Strong curriculum knowledge. Ensure effective academic
delivery.
Pedagogy: Expertise in instructional strategies. Focus on learning outcomes.
Marketing Exposure: Experience in admissions. Drive student enrollment.
Strategic Thinking: Set goals. Plan for long-term growth.
Time Management: Manage responsibilities effectively. Prioritize key tasks.
Conflict Resolution: Mediate issues. Maintain school harmony.
Digital native: Comfortable with whatsapp, mail, drive, chatgpt,
Analytical: Basic functions of excel to analyse student data.

Leadership: Inspire staff. Drive school initiatives.
Communication: Clear and empathetic communication. Listen actively.
Problem Solving: Address issues proactively. Implement solutions
Handling Parents:Resolve issues raised by them. Keep them engaged.
Team Building: Foster collaboration. Recognize team contributions.
Emotional Intelligence: Manage relationships well. Show empathy.

Why Work with Us:
Opportunity to shape the future of education in a dynamic and growth-focused
environment.
Attractive compensation package.
Supportive and collaborative work culture.
Professional development and training opportunities.

If you meet the above requirements and are passionate about education and leadership, we
would love to hear from you. Please send your resume and cover letter to [Email Address].
